technical_inset_note: portrait_v2_inset uses identical raw, whole-canvas isotropic NEAREST containment fit 72x98 into 74x100. It increases output clearance only; it cannot repair an originally clipped source and cannot prove that the raw source had requested 2-3 logical pixels. Here subject outline is visually complete but raw side margins are narrower than requested.
visual_findings: v2纵向原始画幅使74×100中的脸显著大于v1；帽冠与宽领收窄。
三十多岁、低帽檐、灰缕低髻、褪绿巡装与不安警觉闭口保留。
亮眼白仍明显，裸颈仍较长，整体偏干净插画；唯一修订用尽，保留限制或待复核不第三稿。
原始两侧余量13/17像素，主体完整但小于要求的2逻辑像素；技术inset不可当源余量或风格达标。
